author: Inside Edition
description: A treasure trove, hidden since World War II, is finally coming back to light. A castle's chapel in the Czech Republic will display 133 bottles of Chateau D'yquem. The owners of the castle at the time reportedly hid the bottles under the floor in the chapel before fleeing to Austria. Some of the bottles date back to 1892. A French winery took on the task of restoring the bottles. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 133 Bottles Of Century-Old Wine Hidden During WWII Being Restored

author: Inside Edition
description: Something was lurking under the hood of this car, something adorable. Firefighters in Long Beach, California, say they were called to help get a kitten out from its hiding spot near this car's engine. The kitty did not make it easy for its rescuers. The first responders even removed some panels to access the animal, but the scaredy cat just kept crawling deeper inside the vehicle. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Firefighters Save Scared Kitten That Crawled Under Hood Of Car

author: Inside Edition
description: Cat owners in the U.S. should be on the lookout for something called Bobcat Fever, an often fatal feline infection transmitted by ticks.
title: What Is 'Bobcat Fever' And How Can You Protect Your Cat? #shorts
